title: Aquarius: The Friend Zone Clip
old_caption: Three attempts to clip through the friend zone, three bonks. Then the best friend opened a door that was there the whole time. Ever fallen for your best friend?

title: Pisces: Daydream%
old_caption: Split one was eye contact. By split five Pisces had planned the holidays, a dog named Biscuit and growing old together. Then they said hi. Who else daydreams this fast?

title: Taurus × Libra: Co-op, Nobody Texts First
old_caption: Two people, two drafts, two deletes, and nobody sending first. Then the countdown hit zero and both "hi"s collided in the middle. Who usually texts first, you or them?

title: Gemini: Game Over, New Save
old_caption: They said "I see you as a friend", kindly. It still stung, and that's allowed. Then the friends showed up with snacks and a blanket, and a new save file started. Asking was brave.

title: Capricorn: Assisted%
old_caption: The group chat had six scripts ready, including "tell them they're the moon". Capricorn sent its own words instead, and the chat lost it when the yes came in. Who's in your pit crew?

title: Cancer: 100%
old_caption: The full 100% run: eye contact, a dog photo, homemade cookies, the friends' score cards, the first fight and the talk after it. Stay for the final split. What's your favourite stage?

title: Leo: 100%, All Achievements
old_caption: A four-minute voice note, a fairy-light picnic, an interview panel with score cards. Then chapter 6, where the hardest achievement is saying "I missed you". Which chapter got you?

title: Virgo: 100%, Off Route
old_caption: Route v7 had seven perfect steps. Then the restaurant was closed, the board game had 24 pages of rules and the weekend plan had twelve steps. The ending, though. Plan half, wing half?

title: Scorpio: 100%, Final Boss
old_caption: Zero blinks, one-word texts, thirty-seven questions and no answers. Every stage cleared except the last one: a boss called saying how you feel. It only takes three hits. Who needs this?

title: Aquarius: 100%, Co-op Mode
old_caption: Stargazing, octopus facts, an arcade co-op win, a whole chaotic friend group. Then "I need to be alone. forever. no, not forever." The fix was alone time, together. Wait for the last split.
